name: Wander service health
description: Starter NRQL dashboard; replace ACCOUNT_ID when importing manually.

widgets.title: Error logs
widgets.nrql: SELECT count(*) FROM Log WHERE severityText = 'ERROR' FACET service.name TIMESERIES

widgets.title: Provider duration
widgets.nrql: SELECT average(wander.operation.duration) FROM Metric WHERE operation LIKE 'provider.%' FACET operation TIMESERIES
